template.sem_sentence: የግንባታ ኩባንያው {D} ሜትር የውኃ ቱቦ አለው።
template.agreement_note: The counter ሜትር follows the slot and never changes with the number.
template.gloss_en: Seller: Our shop has {M} metres of water pipe. In our shop the water pipe is cut into pieces of {S} metres each. The neighbouring shop has {T} metres of pipe. Customer: So if your shop cut all the pipe it has, how many pieces would come out?
template.notes: Dialogue with labels ሻጭ፦ (seller) and ደንበኛ፦ (customer). The pipe length is divided by the piece length (group size). T is the neighbouring shop's total, a rival total. Extra sentence: the pipes are kept in warehouse section number {D}. Semantic sentence: the construction company has {D} metres of water pipe.
